text: dsh-any-attachment 是一个已停用的旧版 DSH Web 插件，曾在 composer 中增加文件选择、拖放和 @ 工作区文件引用，并通过主机 RPC 将普通附件存入 DSH_HOME/attachments-any。源码还实现文件名校验、上传大小限制和工作区文件列表；但 bundle 当前明确设为 disabled，README 说明 DSH 0.2 已原生支持任意文件且旧 client API 不再兼容。因此它仅适合作为历史实现参考，不应作为当前可用的附件方案。无需 API key；可用 DSH_HOME 指定本机附件目录。

dsh-any-attachment is a disabled legacy DSH Web plugin for file picking, drag and drop, and @ workspace references. Uploads use host RPC and DSH_HOME storage. Its old client API is incompatible with DSH 0.2, which supports arbitrary files natively. Historical reference only; no API key is needed.

想让消息中的文件提及在发送时带上能读取的确切路径。
我需要把 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 交给现有图片输入流程。
I need to browse and autocomplete files from the current session workspace in the composer.
How can I add non-image files to a message in the older DSH web composer?
dsh-any-attachment 的功能「工作区文件提及」：在旧版 Web composer 输入 @ 后按名称筛选会话工作区文件，选中后插入引用；发送时序列化为文件名及对应路径。
dsh-any-attachment 的功能「拖放和按钮上传」：用户可拖入文件或点 composer 的加号选择文件；普通文件经 RPC 上传，成功后在草稿中加入 @文件名引用。
dsh-any-attachment 的功能「私有附件存储」：主机端接收附件数据并写入 DSH_HOME 下的 attachments-any 目录；默认根目录为 ~/.dsh，且通过冲突改名避免覆盖已有文件。
dsh-any-attachment 已过时且 bundle 默认 disabled；README 指出 DSH 0.2 原生接收任意文件，旧 client 所用 composer API 已变更，因此此插件当前不能作为可用附件功能安装。

dsh-any-attachment README · dsh-any-attachment：> ## ⛔ OBSOLETE — do not install
>
> **DSH 0.2 made this redundant.** The composer now accepts files of any type natively:
> `conversation.createDrafts()` turns every picked or dropped file into a `ComposerFileAttachment`
> whose bytes upload to the Host as soon as it is picked — which is precisely what this plugin was
> built to add.
>
> It also no longer *works* on 0.2: its client half calls `createDraftImages` and `addImages`, and
> reads `shell.snapshot` on the composer input — all replaced in the 0.2 conversation API
> (`createDrafts` / `addAttachments` / `state`). Its patch row is therefore inserted `disabled: true`,
> so an accidental install cannot half-load a broken client bundle.
>
> Kept for reference only. The last working 0.1 implementation is in the git history.

dsh-any-attachment README · dsh-any-attachment：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin bundle that lets the Web UI attach files of **any type** as **pathless @-mentions**: type `@` to pick a workspace file, or drop a file (or use the **+** button) to tag it into your message — the agent then reads the file itself with its own tools. Mentions carry the name only, never a path. Raster images keep flowing through the built-in image pipeline. No changes to the harness repo, and nothing is written into your workspaces.

dsh-any-attachment README · How mentions work：- **`@`-list**: in the composer, type `@` and a menu shows the session workspace's files, recursively and flat (`src/main.ts`, `docs/guide.md`, …). Type more to filter; pick one and a pathless `@name` chip is inserted into the draft.
- **Drop / + button**: drop a local file onto the composer (or click **+**) and it is stored privately; the draft gains an `@<stored-name>` chip — no path, no drive letter.
- Send as usual (Enter or the send button) — every mention chip resolves to its **exact file location** in the sent message (`@name (C:\...\absolute\path)`), so the agent reads the file directly instead of guessing where it lives.
- Raster images (png/jpeg/webp/gif) still route to the built-in image pipeline (vision models see them).
- Files live under `$DSH_HOME/attachments-any/` — private, never dumped into a workspace.

dsh-any-attachment README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Zenjibad/dsh-any-attachment
```

Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the page.

dsh-any-attachment README · Limits：| Guard | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Max bytes per file | 25 MB |
| `@`-list depth | 4 levels below the workspace root |
| `@`-list entries | 500 (sorted, `/`-separated relative paths) |
| `@`-list exclusions | hidden (`.`-prefixed) entries and `node_modules` |
| Name | basename only; traversal, separators, drive letters rejected |
| Storage | private store under `$DSH_HOME/attachments-any`, never a workspace |

dsh-any-attachment README · How it works：- **Host** (`lib/`): registers an RPC channel `/attachments-any` (authority `trusted-host`, same LAN fence as `/api`). `list { sessionId }` walks the session workspace recursively and returns relative paths; `upload` validates base64/size/name, writes into the private store, and returns the stored name (deduped with `-2` suffixes). A system-prompt section tells the agent that a referenced `@name` lives at `./<name>` relative to its working directory, or in the private store otherwise.
- **Client** (`client/`): composer `+` button (`conversation.input.left`), a capture-phase drop handler, and an `@file` input-trigger source (workspace autocomplete, pathless picks). Rasters route through `createDraftImages`/`addImages`; everything else uploads via the channel and the mention `@<name>` is appended to the composer draft via `inputActions.setDraft`.
dsh-any-attachment README · How it works：The agent reads the file at the resolved path with its own tools — no extraction, no download UI, no special send flow.

node --test
```
